setup.doneHint: Log purchases as they happen. You can set your monthly ETF investment and savings on the Budget page.
setup.cardHint: {n} quick steps left: balances, income, fixed costs and goals.
setup.sampleDetected: This database still contains the sample data from the first version.
setup.resetHint: Removes transactions, balances, budgets, goals, custom categories, attachments and the Trading 212 connection. Built-in categories and preferences are kept. This cannot be undone.
setup.resetConfirm: I understand all data will be deleted

t212.description: Automatically updates your ETF value, invested capital and positions.
t212.disconnectConfirm: Remove the API key? Already synced history is kept.
t212.fallback: The app keeps using the last saved values.
t212.positionsWarning: The account summary synced, but positions could not be read. Check that the key has portfolio read permission.
t212.step1: In the Trading 212 app: Settings › API (Beta) › Generate API key.
t212.step2: Enable read permissions only: Account data and Portfolio. Do not enable Orders.
t212.step3: Paste the API key and API secret here.
t212.securityStorage: The key is validated and stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM); it is never shown or stored in plain text.
t212.securityReadOnly: NestFund only makes read requests (account summary and positions). It cannot place orders, buy or sell.
t212.securitySchedule: Syncs automatically every 6 hours. If it fails, the app keeps working with manual values.

errors.forbidden: The key has no read permission for this data.
errors.rate_limit: Trading 212 rate limit reached. Try again in a minute.
errors.not_found: Endpoint not found in the Trading 212 API.
errors.blocked: Request blocked: only reads are allowed.
errors.too_soon: Synced moments ago — wait a few seconds.
errors.key_unreadable: The stored key can no longer be read (did NESTFUND_SECRET change?). Paste the key again.
errors.internal: An internal error occurred while saving the sync.

t212.portfolioSynced: Trading 212 syncs automatically; the other accounts are entered manually.
t212.currencyNote: The account is in {currency}; values are shown without converting to euros.
t212.needsAction: Automatic syncs are paused until you update the key.
